packet.title: Serializer: XML and XHTML methods (implementation) — Early

body.p: After , . Owns src/serialize.c, new src/serialize_internal.h, src/serialize_xml.c, tests/serialize_test.c, tests/serialize_xml_test.c. Sequence normalization (Serialization 4.0 "Sequence Normalization"), escaping, namespace fixup and undeclaration, indentation with suppress-indentation, CDATA sections, doctype, XML declaration and standalone, encodings with character references, normalization-form (2.4), character maps; XHTML rules (empty elements, xml:lang). Writes through sxml_output_stream (). Done when method-xml, method-xhtml ≥ 90% under the 3.13 driver (unit cases until then). Spec: Serialization 4.0 "XML Output Method", "XHTML Output Method". Done 2026-10-17 (D120b): src/serialize_internal.h (character pipeline, sequence normalizer), src/serialize_xml.c (XML, XHTML, Canonical XML, adaptive nodes); HTML, text, JSON, CSV return UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE. Unit cases only until the 3.13 driver; XP40 unchanged (26,951). The parameter reader is still undefined (3.4).
